data.name: Vishwavasu
data.gender_notes: Vishwavasu is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vishwavasu is recorded with the meaning “Lord of the Universe”. Vishwavasu is a Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. name meaning “Lord of the Universe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vishwavasu expresses “Lord of the Universe”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: विश्ववासु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Trust in the Universe, a name for Agni, the fire God

in_marathi.name: Vishwavasu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishwavasu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Vishwavasu is a name of the sun-god and also the name of a Gandharva.

in_bengali.name: Vishwavasu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vishwavasu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Vishwavasu is a name of the sun-god and also the name of a Gandharva.
